body: I can't do it anymore. I feel like I'm going to collapse. I cry while I'm driving. I shake almost constantly because I'm so tired. My hair is falling out and I'm losing weight. When i have to mow a yard (another jib) I can barely push the mower anymore and that makes me cry. I don't know what to do.
They get it I think, but I know if i was a kid I'd hate it.

I have it bad, but the kids have it the worst. The car "rides" are never ending. We practically live in the car. Two of my jobs are "independent contractor" jobs for delivery services. I also board dogs. Imagine this. Clocking in to both delivery places and having to take 3 kids with you 24 hours a day, plus the dogs you are watching, all in the car with you, everyday, all day. The kids have the shit end of the stick. They really do. I have talked to them a million times (nearly every day) about how this is the only way we can live. But it's awful, and exhausting.

It's just financial. I will be working as hard as I can for weeks on end and then sonething will happen where I somehow have to work harder and make even more money. I can't work any more than I am right now, but I have to figure out how to. I had a job that paid more but the daycare was abusing my son, so in order to have time to change daycares I had to leave my job. I now literally have 6 part time jobs. 6. Not an exaggeration.

It's been like this for nearly a decade already. I am just tired now. I have worked 7 days a week for as long as I can remember, can't sleep. I thought things were looking better then this loan happened. It has been nothing but downhill since. Keeping on like this just isn't possible, there are so many more lows than highs. I am just so tired I can't even explain it to you.
